_comment: Single source of truth for deal cards on Home and Crypto pages. Edited both via chat (direct edits) and the /#/admin panel (which commits via the GitHub API). Always the latest commit wins. Schema: { amt, who, type, form, when, summary }. If you change this schema, update src/components/DealCard.jsx AND the admin form in src/pages/Admin.jsx in the same commit.

home.summary: Advised investor group whose investments in a Korean asset manager became trapped when FTX filed for chapter 11 and then became subject to the Korean asset manager's post-FTX ponzi scheme. Assisted with engagement of U.S. bankruptcy counsel and all aspects of strategy including with respect to separate bankruptcy proceedings in Korea.

Brokered exclusive sale of minority interest in seized crypto, crypto-backed loans, real estate and other assets held across multiple jurisdictions to a family office buyer. Proceeds used to fund seller's ongoing legal expenses in active DOJ litigation.

Brokered exclusive sale of a rejected licensing agreement claim to a multinational hedge fund group. Structured sale to include contingent consideration for seller based on ultimate allowed amount of claim.
Brokered exclusive sale of Korean crypto exchange claim against Genesis Global to U.K.-based hedge fund with settlement in BTC.
Brokered exclusive secondary sale of Visa/MC claim to prop desk of U.S.-based investment bank.
